## Art

The art in `public/assets/` and `content/tilesets/` comes from
[Flare: Empyrean Campaign](https://github.com/flareteam/flare-game) (commit `af6eee6`),
by Clint Bellanger and contributors.

It is licensed under the
[Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/)
licence (CC-BY-SA 3.0), and so are our versions of it.

**Changes:** the Hero's equipment layers are composited into one outfit;
the character sheets are cut down to the animations Wiablo uses and
repacked; the Projectile sheets are cut down to one direction, which Wiablo
rotates; the tilesets are cut into one padded image per tile for Tiled.
Nothing is recoloured.

## Models

The 3D models in `public/assets/models/` are by Kay Lousberg,
[www.kaylousberg.com](https://www.kaylousberg.com) (KayKit), from
[KayKit-Game-Assets](https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets) on GitHub, under the
[Creative Commons Zero](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)
licence (CC0). Crediting him is not required, and we do.

- Adventurers 1.0: [KayKit-Character-Pack-Adventures-1.0](https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Character-Pack-Adventures-1.0) (commit `672074b`)
- Skeletons 1.0: [KayKit-Character-Pack-Skeletons-1.0](https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Character-Pack-Skeletons-1.0) (commit `15b62b9`)
- Dungeon Remastered 1.0: [KayKit-Dungeon-Remastered-1.0](https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Dungeon-Remastered-1.0) (commit `b0ca9bd`)
- Halloween Bits 1.0: [KayKit-Halloween-Bits-1.0](https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Halloween-Bits-1.0) (commit `6dc69bf`)
- Medieval Hexagon 1.0: [KayKit-Medieval-Hexagon-Pack-1.0](https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Medieval-Hexagon-Pack-1.0) (commit `84fa4e9`)
- Mystery Monthly Series 6: [itch.io](https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-series-6), paid and CC0

**Changes:** the Knight is cut down to the animations Wiablo uses and to
the 1-handed sword and the round shield. The Monstrosity gets the
`Rig_Large` animations Wiablo uses and the Knight's 2-handed chop,
retargeted onto its rig. Halloween Bits and Medieval Hexagon
pieces, which come as glTF with a binary and a texture, are packed into one
glb each. Nothing is recoloured.
